name: Grabbit 0.1.0 beta 2
body:
**Grabbit beta 2.** New: service pills spelled out in their brand colours, and a "buy me a chai" link in Settings. Stream straight from Usenet on your Android phone and Android TV.

> Educational, non-commercial beta. Grabbit hosts no content; you're responsible for what you watch. See the [disclaimer](https://github.com/thisisshub/grabbit#disclaimer).

### Install
1. Download **Grabbit-0.1.0-beta.2.apk** below on your phone (or install it on your TV with the *Downloader* app).
2. Allow "install unknown apps" when asked, open Grabbit and accept the beta notice.
3. Settings: add your Usenet server and Newznab indexer. On a TV, scan the QR code and type them on your phone.

### What's in it
- Instant playback with seeking, straight from Usenet (stored RAR and password-protected 7z sets too)
- What's new and Top 10 on Netflix, Prime Video, Apple TV, JioHotstar and more
- Shows by season with per-episode progress, Continue Watching and next-episode autoplay
- Android TV app; say a title on your phone and it plays on the TV
- Picks releases your device can actually play

### Tell us what you think
In the app: **Settings → Beta feedback** (on TV, scan the QR). It opens a pre-filled, auto-labelled GitHub issue.
